title: Step 2 - How to Install and Initialize H2O for Efficient Deep Learning in R

cues.en: -: Hello and welcome to this R tutorial.
cues.zh: 大家好，歡迎來到這堂 R 教學。

cues.en: So we have a very exciting tutorial ahead of us because in this tutorial we are going to build the ANN and fit it to the training set.
cues.zh: 這堂課很精彩，因為我們將建立人工神經網路，並用訓練集來訓練它。

cues.en: So right now it's time for action and let's build our first artificial neural network.
cues.zh: 現在就開始動手，建立第一個人工神經網路。

cues.en: All right, so as I told you in the previous tutorial, we are gonna use the best package for that.
cues.zh: 如同上一堂課所說，我們會使用最適合這項工作的套件。

cues.en: That is the most efficient one that offers the most options and also one package that can run your models very efficiently.
cues.zh: 這個套件效率最高、提供最多選項，也能非常有效率地執行模型。

cues.en: That's indeed very important because the models that we're gonna build are complex and you know, they can run over many epochs.
cues.zh: 這確實很重要，因為我們建立的模型相當複雜，而且可能要執行很多個訓練週期。

cues.en: So we need a package that will be efficient for these highly compute intensive tasks that are inevitable when we build a deep learning model.
cues.zh: 建立深度學習模型時，這些高運算量的工作無可避免，因此需要能有效率處理它們的套件。

cues.en: In this section, in this tutorial, we're not gonna build a very deep learning model.
cues.zh: 這個章節、這堂課要建立的模型，層數不會非常深。

cues.en: We are gonna have indeed two hidden layers, but still, and if you need to work with a deeper artificial neural network well of course it's better if you have the best package.
cues.zh: 我們會用兩個隱藏層。不過，若你需要更深的人工神經網路，當然還是使用最好的套件比較理想。

cues.en: So there are several deep learning packages in R.
cues.zh: R 有好幾個深度學習套件。

cues.en: So we have neuralnet to build deep learning models that are regressors and not classifiers.
cues.zh: 例如 neuralnet，可以建立用於迴歸而非分類的深度學習模型。

cues.en: So we cannot use this one.
cues.zh: 因此我們不能用這個。

cues.en: Then we have nnet that allows to build a deep learning classifier model, but with only one hidden layer.
cues.zh: 還有 nnet，可以建立深度學習分類模型，但只能有一個隱藏層。

cues.en: And then we have deepnet, another very good deep learning package that can build deep learning models with many hidden layers.
cues.zh: 另外還有 deepnet，也是很好的深度學習套件，能建立具有多個隱藏層的模型。

cues.en: But that's still not the one we're gonna use.
cues.zh: 不過，我們也不會用它。

cues.en: And so now I'm gonna tell you the one that we're gonna use, it is called the h2o package.
cues.zh: 我們要使用的套件叫作 h2o。

cues.en: So why is it, in my opinion, the best package to build deep learning models?
cues.zh: 為什麼我認為它是建立深度學習模型的最佳套件？

cues.en: Well, it's for three reasons.
cues.zh: 有三個原因。

cues.en: The first reason, and that's the most important reason, is that h2o is an open source software platform that allows you to connect to an instance
cues.zh: 第一個，也是最重要的原因，是 h2o 為開放原始碼軟體平台，能讓你連線到

cues.en: of a computer system that therefore allows you to run your model very efficiently.
cues.zh: 電腦系統的執行個體，讓模型執行得非常有效率。

cues.en: So thanks to this connection to this computer system, we will be able to train a deep learning model very efficiently, like in a few seconds.
cues.zh: 透過與這個電腦系統連線，我們就能非常有效率地訓練深度學習模型，例如幾秒鐘就完成。

cues.en: For those of you who followed the Python tutorials, it's like connecting to a GPU, you know, that allows you to run highly compute intensive parallel computations.
cues.zh: 如果你看過 Python 教學，這就像連接 GPU，讓你執行運算量很大的平行運算。

cues.en: So that's the first reason, efficiency.
cues.zh: 所以第一個原因是效率。

cues.en: Now, the second reason is that this package offers a lot of options to build your deep learning model.
cues.zh: 第二個原因是，這個套件提供許多建立深度學習模型的選項。

cues.en: So you know, it'll be very easy for us to choose different numbers of hidden layers and choose different numbers of neurons in the hidden layers as well as other options to develop your model.
cues.zh: 我們可以很輕鬆地選擇隱藏層的數量、各隱藏層的神經元數量，以及其他模型開發選項。

cues.en: And speaking of options, that leads me to the third reason why to me, it is the best deep learning package.
cues.zh: 說到選項，就帶出了我認為它是最佳深度學習套件的第三個原因。

cues.en: Well, the third reason is that one option of this h2o package is that it contains a parameter tuning argument that allows you to choose some optimal numbers to build your deep learning model.
cues.zh: 第三個原因是，h2o 套件有參數調校的引數，能讓你選用最佳數值來建立深度學習模型。

cues.en: So we will see that by building the model.
cues.zh: 建立模型時，我們就會看到。

cues.en: And so let's start creating it.
cues.zh: 現在開始建立吧。

cues.en: So the first thing we have to do is of course to install the h2o package.
cues.zh: 首先，當然要安裝 h2o 套件。

cues.en: So let's do this.
cues.zh: 我們就來做。

cues.en: We're gonna use the install.packages command.
cues.zh: 使用 install.packages 指令。

cues.en: Here we go.
cues.zh: 像這樣。

cues.en: And remember, in this install.packages function, we need to input the name of the package in quotes, that is h2o.
cues.zh: 記得在 install.packages 函式內，要用引號括住套件名稱，也就是 h2o。

cues.en: So that's all, h2o written this simple way.
cues.zh: 就這樣，簡單寫成 h2o。

cues.en: And so you just need to select this line and execute it to install the package.
cues.zh: 選取這一行並執行，就能安裝套件。

cues.en: I already have it installed on my R studio, here it is.
cues.zh: 我的 RStudio 已經安裝了，就在這裡。

cues.en: And it's also already imported.
cues.zh: 而且也已經載入了。

cues.en: But of course this will install this package without any issue.
cues.zh: 這樣就能順利安裝套件。

cues.en: And of course, if you have any issue, you can ask me some questions in the Q and A, I'll help you fix that.
cues.zh: 如果遇到任何問題，可以在問與答區提問，我會協助你解決。

cues.en: So I'm gonna put that in comment.
cues.zh: 我先把這行註解掉。

cues.en: And now let's move on to the next line, which is to import this package in case we have to automate the scripts.
cues.zh: 接著到下一行，載入這個套件，這樣腳本需要自動執行時也能運作。

cues.en: So to import it, as usual, we use library and in parenthesis, not in quotes, the name of the package h2o.
cues.zh: 和往常一樣，用 library 載入，在括號中填入套件名稱 h2o，不加引號。

cues.en: Alright, great.
cues.zh: 好，很棒。

cues.en: And now we need to do something special.
cues.zh: 現在要做一件特別的事。

cues.en: It's not the usual package that we've been using throughout this course.
cues.zh: 這和我們在這門課裡一直使用的一般套件不同。

cues.en: It's a new kind of package, because it's a package that we're taking from an open source platform, and therefore that requires a connection to an h2o instance.
cues.zh: 這是另一種套件，來自開放原始碼平台，因此需要連線到一個 h2o 執行個體。

cues.en: And therefore, what we'll do right now before starting to create the model is to establish this connection.
cues.zh: 所以在開始建立模型之前，我們先建立這個連線。

cues.en: And don't worry, that's very easy.
cues.zh: 別擔心，非常簡單。

cues.en: We need to take our package h2o then dot, and then as you can see here it contains many functions and the function we're interested in
cues.zh: 先輸入套件名稱 h2o，再加上句點。你可以看到它有很多函式，我們需要用來

cues.en: to make this connection and in fact, initialize an h2o instance, well we need to take the init function.
cues.zh: 建立連線、也就是初始化 h2o 執行個體的，是 init 函式。

cues.en: All right?
cues.zh: 好嗎？

cues.en: And as you can see in this function we have several parameters that allows you to connect to a specific server.
cues.zh: 可以看到，這個函式有好幾個參數，讓你連線到指定的伺服器。

cues.en: For example, this first argument here is IP, which you can use to specify the IP address of the server you want to connect to in which your h2o instance will be running.
cues.zh: 例如第一個引數 ip，可以指定要連線的伺服器 IP 位址，h2o 執行個體會在那裡執行。

cues.en: But that's only if you have an idea of which server you want to connect to.
cues.zh: 但這是在你已經知道要連線到哪台伺服器的情況下才用。

cues.en: But in our case, we will connect to some sort of a default available server.
cues.zh: 我們則會連線到預設可用的伺服器。

cues.en: And therefore we won't use these parameters here.
cues.zh: 因此不會使用這裡的這些參數。

cues.en: However, there is one that will use, and it is the nthreads parameter here.
cues.zh: 不過有一個參數我們會用，就是 nthreads。

cues.en: And what is this argument?
cues.zh: 這個引數是什麼呢？

cues.en: While this argument is the number of cores in the system that you're connecting to that will be used to build the deep learning model, because you know building a deep learning model
cues.zh: 它指定在連線的系統中，用多少個核心來建立深度學習模型。因為建立深度學習模型

cues.en: requires a lot of computations, highly compute intensive ones, and therefore we need many cores to run these computations.
cues.zh: 需要大量、非常密集的運算，所以我們需要多個核心來執行。

cues.en: And again, that's the reason why we prefer GPUs or CPUs, because simply GPUs have many more cores.
cues.zh: 這也是我們偏好 GPU 而非 CPU 的原因，因為 GPU 的核心數量多得多。

cues.en: So here, we'll take this argument and thread.
cues.zh: 所以這裡選取 nthreads 引數。

cues.en: And now the trick is to input the value minus one, because specifying this minus one value will take all the available cores of the system you're connecting to.
cues.zh: 訣竅是填入 -1；指定這個值，就會使用所連線系統的全部可用核心。

cues.en: So don't even think about it.
cues.zh: 因此不用多想。

cues.en: I strongly recommend to use minus one here because this will optimize the number of cores to use and therefore the future computations.
cues.zh: 我強烈建議這裡用 -1，讓核心使用數量以及後續運算達到最佳效果。

cues.en: Great.
cues.zh: 很好。

cues.en: And that's actually the only argument we need to input here in this init function.
cues.zh: 這也是 init 函式在這裡唯一需要填入的引數。

cues.en: So we are ready to execute that to connect to the system.
cues.zh: 現在就可以執行，連線到系統了。

cues.en: All right, so let's execute starting h2o jvn and connecting.
cues.zh: 來執行，正在啟動 h2o JVM 並建立連線。

cues.en: And here we go.
cues.zh: 好了。

cues.en: All the connections are established, and now we are working on another system.
cues.zh: 所有連線都已建立，現在我們是在另一個系統上工作。

cues.en: Much more powerful because we have an optimized number of cores, and so we are ready to build any kind of complex deep learning models.
cues.zh: 這個系統更強大，因為已最佳化核心數量，所以我們可以建立各種複雜的深度學習模型了。

cues.en: Great, so now we have everything we need.
cues.zh: 很好，所需的一切都已備妥。

cues.en: We have a powerful tool with us.
cues.zh: 我們已經有強大的工具。

cues.en: So we are definitely ready to start building the deep learning model.
cues.zh: 現在完全準備好開始建立深度學習模型了。

cues.en: All right, so that's what we're gonna do starting from the next tutorial.
cues.zh: 下一堂課就會開始動手。

cues.en: Until then, enjoy machine learning.
cues.zh: 在那之前，祝你享受機器學習的樂趣。
